scope: Bounded engineering counterexamples, not accuracy/representation/retention experiments

shared_postquery_trunk_counterexample.conclusion: Original R5 post-query trunk is not necessarily query invariant. A theorem assuming the same s for both queries cannot be applied to it without that condition.

ablation_optimizer_counterexample.conclusion: Pre-gating ablation uses hard argmax perceptron errors; CKCER uses softmax probability errors. The ladder changes more than just the named feature factor.

cap.kind: Windows per-process committed memory; shared pages monitored separately
